name: Meridian Zeppelin — Cargo Class
description: The return of the airship. Ferrogate's cargo zeppelins cruise above the city at 60 km/h, carrying containers that would take a convoy of trucks to move on the ground. They're slow, majestic, and economical — helium lift does most of the work, and the electric propulsion just provides direction. Watching a cargo zeppelin drift through the industrial district skyline at sunset is one of the genuinely beautiful sights in GLMZ. The crews who work them are a breed apart — sky sailors in a city of ground-crawlers.
cost: Φ2,000,000 per vessel. Cargo rates: Φ5-15 per kg.
autonomy: Human crew (8-12) with AI navigation assist
armament: None standard. Point defense systems on high-value routes.
common_usage: Bulk cargo transport, heavy equipment delivery, inter-city logistics.
story_hooks: A cargo zeppelin crew discovers a stowaway who has been living in the cargo bay for weeks — they came from somewhere the zeppelin has never been
A zeppelin goes dark over the lake and drifts for three hours before the crew comes back online with no memory of what happened
